41aa0e3578.why: All four rounded products are live, and AVX2 VPMULHRSW cannot fold the required scalar broadcasts into its memory operands.

119b748ebe.why: The three sequential rounded multiplications cannot be reassociated, and the loaded coefficient, zero vector, broadcast result, store, and counter update are all required.

ef076b7d90.why: The unpack operand ymm18 is unconstrained, both arithmetic results must be preserved, and the packing, stores, and scalar updates remain necessary.

fb19cb178e.why: Each broadcast feeds a required rounded product, and AVX-512 VPMULHRSW does not support embedded scalar broadcasts.

8fec1ae111.why: Each destructive dot-product accumulator requires initialization from the arbitrary bias vector, while the independent products, masked multishifts, and saturating packs cannot be combined.

e42789eb12.why: All eight output vectors require independent biased dot products, and the arbitrary bias, shift controls, and merge mask prevent removing accumulator copies or combining the result operations.

632c12d4dc.why: The sequential rounded products and broadcast are required, and both the preserved zero vector and zero store must remain alongside the carry-producing counter update.

3583e55274.why: The arbitrary unpack and add operands require both word-processing paths, with both vector results, both stores, and both scalar updates preserved.

90e608284c.why: The rounded products require separate broadcasts, and the final copy is necessary because both zmm16 and zmm20 must contain the last product.

20d780fd0c.why: Every rounded product is live, and the word multiplication instruction cannot absorb any of the scalar broadcasts.

207be587e7.why: Every instruction establishes a distinct required vector value, with the zero and constant vectors already produced in one instruction each.

f7b1f1680b.why: The unpack operand and coefficients are arbitrary, the arithmetic intermediates are live, and SSE2 has no suitable fused instruction for the required unpack, multiply, and accumulation steps.

06fc5ebf68.why: The SSE2 filter requires its unpack and arithmetic stages, while the destination-pixel load must also remain to preserve xmm1 and supply the final average.

ca02114d11.why: All four loads are live, and constructing the required repeated 0xffc0 words still needs both the comparison and shift under SSSE3.

6c77655829.why: The arbitrary shuffle masks and coefficients require both filtering paths, and the preserved xmm1 result prevents eliminating the high-half move before the saturating addition.

ccb566873d.why: Both filtering paths and their live intermediates are required, including the high-half move and the destination-pixel load that establishes the preserved xmm7 value.

c4a18fc463.why: The pairwise multiply-adds already fuse the filter arithmetic, while the required unpacking, live temporary values, saturation, and rounding leave no removable instruction.

972fcff618.why: The filter already uses fused pairwise multiply-adds, and its live intermediates plus the preserved destination-pixel vector prevent dropping loads or arithmetic stages.

4d7660ca41.why: Both unpack halves and the filter intermediates are live, and folding the unaligned loads into legacy SSE unpack memory operands would introduce alignment requirements.

d0e3a62d24.why: Both unpack halves and filter intermediates remain necessary, the average load is already folded into PAVGB, and legacy SSE unpack memory operands cannot safely replace the unaligned input loads.
